
DESCRIPTION
生成工作区工具配置

USAGE
  one init [flags]

SUBCOMMANDS
  hooks          Generate hk checks, migrate default Husky hooks, and install local Git launchers
  mise           Generate or refresh optional mise tool and task configuration

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)
